Measurement channels

The NG-4 recorder samples channel TS-04 every 200 ms.

The reference thermocouple uncertainty is ±0.25 °C.

Telemetry export

  1. Connect the RS-485 adapter.
  2. Set the bit rate to 115200 baud.
